text:
Type: low red metal coffee table on casters
Use: holding drinks, magazines or a TV, moving around easily; living room, kids room, studio
Style: industrial, retro, contemporary
Materials: red powder-coated steel, visible screws, rubber wheels
Colors: bright red, white wheels
Shape: rectangular top with rounded edges, open lower shelf, square tube legs, four swivel casters, cart-like, compact
Feel: bold, playful, energetic, practical
Goes with: white or grey walls, black accents, light wood floors; retro, industrial or modern living rooms and kids rooms

product.name: IKEA PS 2012
product.description: The castors make it easy to move the table if needed.
